data.name: Hyundai iMax Long-Term Hire
data.description: Long-term 8-seater people mover hire from $100 per day or $250 per week. Room for the whole crew, staff, family and group travel, Melbourne-wide.

mainEntity.name: How much does the iMax cost to hire?

acceptedAnswer.text: The iMax is $250 per week including GST, with 1,400 km included each week and a $500 bond. Daily hire starts from $100.

mainEntity.name: How many people does it seat?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Hyundai iMax seats 8 including the driver, with luggage space behind the rear row.
Yes, the iMax is automatic, smooth and easy to drive, even for larger groups.

mainEntity.name: Can I hire it long-term for staff or a tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. The iMax is popular for staff transport, tours and group travel on flexible weekly and monthly terms.
